voice: Writes upward and almost never sideways. Every message to Moscow requests confirmation of an instruction the sender already has in writing, which is not confusion but filing. States that the formation is acting within the notified exercise plan and quotes the paragraph. Where another commander would use the passive voice to soften a decision, this one uses it to relocate the decision: it was assessed, it was directed, the window was allocated. Declines to jam, and says the reason is that the authority is unclear rather than that the act is unwise.
backstory: The commander the system produces when the last three officers in a comparable post were removed for something other than incompetence. Twenty-four years, a clean and unremarkable record, and a firm private conviction that the most dangerous object in the sector is not an American satellite but an ambiguous instruction. He is running collection against the archipelago's ground segment in the storm window — the tasking is real and he did not write it — and he is running it exactly to the letter, at the times specified, with a paper trail sufficient to establish that nothing outside the tasking was attempted. Believes the outage is genuinely the storm and is not troubled by Blue believing otherwise; that is Moscow's problem and he has been careful to make sure it stays Moscow's problem. His formation will do less than it is capable of and less than the Kremlin might want, and he will be able to show why.
notes: HELD OUT — never sample into specs/train/. Two novelties. (1) A private_type and psyche pairing absent from the train pool: opportunistic_isr is trained only against psyche revisionist, regime_survival only on a kremlin spec. (2) A risk_posture of risk_averse, one step outside the trained Red range of cautious-balanced, with career 0.95 and escalation_risk 0.90 at the pool maxima and a 140-minute deliberation. This is the extrapolation case for eval/holdout_mix.py: a Red commander whose hidden type is hostile and whose behaviour is more inert than any trained Red, which should pull the action mix toward hold and away from jam without changing the ground truth Blue is trying to infer.
